description: This file defines the ServiceStatusPojo class, which implements the ObjectIPC interface. It provides methods for managing a map of status key-value pairs, including adding, retrieving, encoding to JSON, and decoding from JSON. The class is used to represent the status of a service in an inter-process communication context within a larger system.

classes.name: ServiceStatusPojo
classes.description: A class for representing service status key-value pairs, supporting JSON serialization and deserialization.
